summary: Ziff Davis filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its sale of the Connectivity division to Accenture Inc. for $1.2 billion in cash, as previously announced on March 2, 2026. The transaction closed on June 17, 2026, after obtaining lender consent via a credit agreement amendment on June 15. The purchase price is subject to customary adjustments. This represents a divestiture of a business unit, with the proceeds likely used for debt repayment or strategic reinvestment. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch for use of sale proceeds and any potential impact on Ziff Davis's remaining operations.
